shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && git log --stat | head -30
cat package.json src/*.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

rg -n -C 6 "navigation" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; npm --version

npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies dependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; grep -n icons package.json package-lock.json | head -5

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@^7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 @bem-react/classname@^1.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -n gravity package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json; rg -n -i "required setup|styles|import" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components; wc -l $D/AsideHeader.md; rg -n -C 3 "FooterItem|renderFooter|headerDecoration|subheaderItems|multipleTooltip|MenuItem\b|onItemClick|qa|itemWrapper|hideCollapseButton|onClosePanel" $D/AsideHeader.md | head -150

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components; sed -n 480,520p $D/AsideHeader.md; sed -n 309,345p $D/AsideHeader.md; ls $D; rg -n -C 3 "FooterItem" $D/AsideHeader.md | sed -n 1,10p; rg -n "export.*FooterItem|FooterItemProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head
wc -l .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -250
sed -n 250,373p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg -n -C3 "useTheme|useThemeValue|ThemeProvider" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -80
head -60 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; wc -l __agent_eval__/run.mjs

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Switch Card Text Flex Label useTheme 2>&1 | head -40; N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; rg -n "renderFooter|renderContent|logo\??:|compact\??:|onChangeCompact" $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts $N/components/AsideHeader/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -l "\.css" $N/index.js $N/components/AsideHeader/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E "^(House|Gear|Sun|Moon|ListUl|CircleInfo|ChartColumn|Person|Persons|SquareListUl|LayoutCellsLarge|Rocket)\.d\.ts"

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Switch Card Text Flex Label 2>&1 | head -40; sed -n 55,75p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts | head -30

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls $U | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat $U/controls/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; find $U -name "SegmentedRadioGroup*.d.ts" -o -name "Switch.d.ts" -o -name "Card.d.ts" | head; rg -n -A12 "interface LogoProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head -70; cat $U/theme/useTheme.d.ts $U/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls $U/layout; rg -n "theme" $U/theme/types.d.ts | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n -A14 "interface ControlGroupProps|interface ControlGroupOption" $U/types.d.ts; rg -n "content|onUpdate|checked|size" $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts $U/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "theme\?|size\?|icon\?" $U/Label/Label.d.ts; rg -n "variant|color\?" $U/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "Variant =|color" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n "^\s+(wrap|gap|direction|alignItems|justifyContent|grow|basis|shrink|width|spacing)\??:" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; rg -n -A6 "interface FooterItemProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; sed -n 1,20p $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts; rg -n "onUpdate" $U/controls/types.d.ts $U/types.d.ts | head

rg -n "p\?|px\?|py\?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/spacing/spacing.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "extends" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -3

sed -i "s/ style={{ padding: 'var(--g-spacing-5)' }}/ spacing={{ p: 5 }}/" src/pages/HomePage.tsx src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""              style={{ padding: 'var(--g-spacing-4) var(--g-spacing-5)' }}
""","""              spacing={{ py: 4, px: 5 }}
""")
s=s.replace("""              <Label theme={STATUS[project.status].theme} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
                {STATUS[project.status].text}
              </Label>""","""              <Flex shrink={0}>
                <Label theme={STATUS[project.status].theme}>{STATUS[project.status].text}</Label>
              </Flex>""")
s=s.replace("style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}","grow basis={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "spacing\|shrink\|grow" src/pages/*.tsx; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
cat .gitignore; sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/; s#<title>Gravity UI eval</title>#<title>Демо-приложение</title>#' index.html; git status --short
rm -rf dist
